clips.title: The story
paras: Undead fill the Dawning Wood Catacombs beneath Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood. Their stone tunnels hold skeletal guards and ravenous ghouls.

The Dawning Wood Catacombs lie beneath the ruined Raven Hill Cemetery. Before the twilight curse came over the forest, the dead of the surrounding woods rested in these stone corridors. Now the catacombs hold some of the region’s deadliest undead, and their depths are dangerous for lone travelers. Two subterranean wings divide the catacombs. Ranks of animated skeletons guard ancestral tombs in the western passages. To the east, the tunnels descend into a foul warren overrun by ravenous, disease-bearing ghouls.
